sentence: This project studies how proteins that regulate plant growth control gene expression and how a protein kinase affects their activity.
This project studies how immune genes and gut microbial communities relate to disease in the gyrfalcon, an Arctic raptor.
This project studies how wear in the storage circuits of analog artificial intelligence systems creates security vulnerabilities and develops ways to reduce them.
This project builds a technology that sequences peptides that drive immune responses, using a silicon-based chip and optical hardware.
This project studies how forest ecosystems respond over the long term to disturbance such as changing climate and changing atmospheric chemistry.
This project uses laser pulses and computer simulations to study how the shapes of molecules that model the sugar-phosphate backbone of DNA affect their fast motions.
This project studies how vision loss changes plasticity in visual and auditory areas of the mouse brain.
This project builds a free software program that uses mathematical rules to create realistic 3D scenes and images for training computer vision systems.
This project uses aircraft, radars and other instruments to find out how different processes decide what type of precipitation falls in near-freezing weather.
This project tests whether stem cells delivered in tiny hydrogel droplets help tendon and ligament injuries in horses heal faster and more completely.
This project uses theory and computer simulations to design electro-optic materials for chips that run quantum computing.
This project studies what causes agricultural flash droughts, how to forecast them, and how they change under climate change.
This project improves a land surface model by letting photosynthetic capacity change over space and time, to better simulate crops and the atmosphere.
This project tests whether biochemicals released by exercising muscle make hippocampal cells contract and produce neurons in mice.
This project develops ways to check that computer chips work correctly and securely, using machine learning and large language models.
This project tests ways to digitize signals from silicon sensors with picosecond timing resolution and builds machine learning methods to reconstruct them.
This project builds a sprayable hydrogel and a hand-held device that protect gastrointestinal lesions and stop bleeding during endoscopic procedures.
